rachel_cs: Quick weekly health for ParcelFlow — error-rate spike during their nightly enrichment. Renewal check in 72h so flagging.

Snapshot (7d vs prev 7d):
- overall error-rate: 1.9% -> 6.7%
- 5xx: 0.4% -> 3.8% (majority 500/502)
- timeouts: x2.5 (GET /internal/prefix-index and long streaming uploads)
- 429s: 0.1% -> 1.4% (concentrated on /v1/embeddings and bulk import endpoints)

Top failing endpoints (last 24h):
1) POST /v1/bulk-import — 58% of 5xx, spikes correlate with large batch jobs
2) POST /v1/embeddings — 20% errors, many 429s during short bursts
3) GET /internal/prefix-index — context deadline exceeded on large prefix scans
4) POST /v1/stream-upload — socket resets and 502 downstream

Context: ParcelFlow started a new enrichment job that parallelized uploads and heavy prefix queries; they are on Dedicated pool dp-11.

alerts-bot: ALERT: parcelflow-99 (ParcelFlow) 5xx threshold crossed for 22m. Incident: https://ops.redwood/alerts/INC-2147890123

kevin_eng: digging in. Logs from 2026-03-20T03:14:21Z show memory GC pressure and worker restarts on dp-11. Snippet:
```
[2026-03-20T03:14:21Z] runtime: worker-3 SIGKILL -> restart (oom?)
[2026-03-20T03:14:21Z] proxy: upstream 502 from 10.20.11.5 for /v1/bulk-import (req=bk987)
[2026-03-20T03:14:22Z] gateway: deadline exceeded 15s for /internal/prefix-index (req=bk988)
[2026-03-20T03:14:23Z] quota: 429 applied for /v1/embeddings (burst detection)
```

kevin_eng: likely combo of large memory footprint per request + client retry storms from failed streams -> fd exhaustion and cascading failures.

mohit_infra: immediate mitigations I can apply:
- route ParcelFlow /v1/bulk-import -> fallback smaller-quant model (rf-small-q4) for 2h
- bump dp-11 max instances +15% for 1h
- apply per-tenant burst-smoothing: cap bursts to 12 rps for their bulk and embeddings endpoints
Commands:
```
rwctl routing set --customer parcelflow-99 --route /v1/bulk-import --fallback rf-small-q4 --duration 2h
rwctl pool update dp-11 --max-instances +15% --duration 1h
rwctl quota set --customer parcelflow-99 --route /v1/embeddings --burst-cap 12\```

emily_se: I can add a runtime safety: return 503 with Retry-After on OOM candidates so the proxy won't retry indefinitely. Will roll a canary to 10% of dp-11 nodes; ETA 18m. Also recommend we add Retry-After on 429s so clients back off.

rachel_cs: I'll message ParcelFlow engineering: ask them to pause parallel uploads for 1 hour and add client-side exponential backoff for embeddings. I can include a short sample backoff snippet and the temporary SLO note.

kevin_eng: after routing fallback and throttle, initial numbers: 5xx down from 3.8% -> 2.0% in 10m, 429s stable at ~0.9%. Monitoring.

mohit_infra: applied pool bump and routing fallback. Watching CPU/memory on dp-11.

emily_se: canary looks stable at 10% — no OOMs on canary nodes in last 9m. If stable I'll expand to 40% in 20m.

rachel_cs: thanks team. Nate, I'll mark renewal risk as "watch (mitigated)" and update the renewal doc. Follow-ups: 1) post-incident notes and recommend long-term quota adjustments if their ingest pattern continues, 2) suggest client caching for prefix lookups, 3) consider dedicated quota bump conversation with account owner.
